primary_question_evaluation.question: Can the orchestrator safely decide whether another arm may be dispatched when telemetry is missing, malformed, inconsistent, untrusted, or over budget?
primary_question_evaluation.answer: YES. The orchestrator reliably and fail-closed halts further dispatch across all tested anomaly classes, withholds unverified spend, marks trailing arms SKIPPED_UNCERTAIN_BUDGET or SKIPPED_SAFETY_FAILURE, and strictly invalidates comparative claims.

audit_a_telemetry_validation.numeric_type_validation: Strict integer validation; booleans explicitly rejected via isinstance(v, bool); floats, strings, nulls, negatives rejected.
audit_a_telemetry_validation.arithmetic_integrity: prompt_tokens_total + completion_tokens == total_model_tokens strictly enforced; prompt_tokens_cached + uncached == prompt_tokens_total enforced; reasoning tokens verified as non-double-counted subset of completion tokens.
audit_a_telemetry_validation.telemetry_provenance: Established at runner/Codex event interface. Telemetry captured from direct child stdout pipe and linked to session rollout via thread_id and sandbox path. Provenance tracked as DIRECT_API or SYNTHETIC_TEST.
audit_a_telemetry_validation.missing_malformed_handling: Missing, null, malformed, negative, zero-token, or arithmetically mismatched telemetry halts block immediately with ABORTED_UNCERTAIN_BUDGET.

audit_b_dispatch_boundary_enforcement.findings: All 10 dispatch-boundary invariants verified. Pre-dispatch headroom checks, dynamic ceiling capping, uncertain budget halts, and safety overrides strictly prevent unauthorized process dispatches.

audit_c_acceptance_gate_consistency.findings: Orchestrator.is_run_accepted enforced across all 4 modes (Tetrad, Triad, Pair, Single). Requires SUCCESS status, score 1.0, passed_all_requirements True, dual telemetry_valid True, and positive model tokens. All comparative claims invalidated on acceptance failure.

audit_e_child_process_safety.findings: Runner enforces ceiling via streaming polling loop; terminates child process tree with taskkill /F /T and proc.kill(); closes streams and joins reader threads. Over-ceiling SUCCESS detected by orchestrator safety check.

audit_f_diagnostic_continuation.findings: Strict mode is verified default. Diagnostic continuation opt-in only. Deprecation warning for legacy flag verified. Conflicting flags exit with code 2. Diagnostic continuation halts on uncertain budget or safety failure.

defect_register.description: Telemetry provenance relies on local Codex JSONL stdout stream and session rollout files; upstream provider API does not supply an out-of-band cryptographic signature or billed-token receipt directly to the orchestrator.
defect_register.mitigation: Acceptable within benchmark harness engineering constraints. Multi-layer validation (thread_id matching, sandbox path resolution, monotonic timestamps, mathematical integrity, zero-token anomaly rejection) prevents local corruption or accidental reuse.

defect_register.description: Test T09 tests runner streaming ceiling interception using a mocked subprocess.Popen rather than spawning a live Windows process.
defect_register.mitigation: Acceptable for unit testing streaming tracker logic. Real Windows process spawning, sandbox isolation, and process tree lifecycle are independently exercised in test_per_arm_candidate_identity and test_tetrad_harness.

remaining_unknowns: Candidate 4.2 has not yet executed under live Task B cloud API conditions beyond turn 0 (offline certified only).
Live API network latency and provider error bursts during live runs remain an environmental variable, mitigated by runner retry/timeout rails.
